answer: Keep unvested rewards in a vault a clone cannot reach: bind every grader seat to a kernel-supplied nonce derived from the previous epoch seed, so a clone must replay the full attestation history before it can grade. The attacker pays one ed25519 signature, about 2^18 sha256 stamp hashes per identity, and a bond of spendable POA that slashes when the sealed score mismatches the panel median. Because the seed is unpredictable before the epoch opens, parallel precomputation saves nothing, and the quartz-like hardness of the target means a sybil farm gains no weight it did not pay for.
